My dear [Henrietta](../persons.html#538)
I believe Goosedom is to be revived in the new members, not that new ones are ever so good as old.

The two first proposed are accepted, and I hope your [Lilian](../persons.html#1008) will be, but you will hear from the [Secretary](../persons.html#329).[^2] I am afraid I did not find her out at the Patteson’s party.[^3] We shall have to make a new arrangement as to circulation which you shall hear in the next Cackle when it is matured

yo
[signature cut out]

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: The two new members of the [Gosling Society](../others.html#104) were [Frances Mary Peard](../persons.html#1160) and [Florence Wilford](../persons.html#1520).

[^3]: The Pattesons were [Joan](../persons.html#1154) and [Fanny Patteson](../persons.html#1151), who lived at Torquay, not far from Lilian Mitchell\'s home at Kingsteignton.
